name: 追魂斩
description: 每逢偶数战斗轮，锁定4格内1个敌方目标。敌方行动时对其造成等同攻击力的伤害，无视距离与阻挡。
code: function executeSkill(context){var source=context.piece,world=battle.extensions.adventureWorld,plan=world.plans[0];if(!plan||plan.sourceId!==source.instanceId||plan.kind!=='attack'||source.x!==plan.origin.x||source.y!==plan.origin.y)return {success:false,message:'预告计划已失效'};var target=battle.pieces.find(function(p){return p.instanceId===plan.trackingTargetId&&p.currentHp>0&&p.x!==null&&p.y!==null;});var z=world.activeZone;if(!target||arePlayersAllied(battle,target.ownerPlayerId,source.ownerPlayerId)||!z||target.x<z.x||target.y<z.y||target.x>=z.x+z.width||target.y>=z.y+z.height)return {success:true,message:'追魂斩的锁定目标已离场'};dealDamage(source,target,source.attack,'physical',battle,context.skill.id);return {success:true,message:'追魂斩命中锁定目标'};}
